_doc: Omega Sector (progression step 7, spec #449 C2 #464): the region's three maps (221040000 Kulan Field I, 221030200 Boswell Field II, 221030500 Boswell Field V; each map entry also imports its life mobs, backs, tiles, objs, BGM and map mark), its pool mobs (Barnard Gray, Mateon, Plateon, Mecateon), its three bosses (Chief Gray, MT-09, Zeno; Chief Gray's MobSkill 200 summons Barnard Gray, already in the pool) and the EXP pickup items of survivor/mobs.json (Etc items, tier C association to each mob), and Effect.wz/Summon.img/6, Chief Gray's MobSkill 200 summonEffect.
